newsitem.title: USA: Home Depot names new CEO, splits stock, ups dividend.
newsitem.headline: Home Depot names new CEO, splits stock, ups dividend.

text.p: Home Depot Inc. said Wednesday it named President Arthur Blank to the additional post of chief executive officer.
Blank, 54, succeeds Bernard Marcus, 68, who remains chairman of the board and the board's executive committee, the company said.
The hardware retailer also announced a three-for-two stock split and increased its quarterly dividend to 7.5 cents a share from 6 cents, payable July 3 to shareholders of record as of June 12.
On a post-split basis, the dividend is equivalent to 5 cents a share, the company said.
Home Depot, based in Atlanta, operates 540 home improvement stores throughout North America.
Home Depot's stock rose 87.5 cents to $61.625 on the New York Stock Exchange at midday.
